text:
elaine_sales: Heads-up — Prospect 'AtlasHealth' asking for a bespoke POC bundle. They want 3-month POC + option to convert to Dedicated. Asking for 40% off list for the POC and 20% on conversion. Need deal desk sign-off and engineering sign-off on latency SLOs.
chris_deals: 40% on POC is aggressive but not impossible for strategic healthcare. Do we have a precedent?
elaine_sales: Not exactly. We gave 35% once for a healthcare pilot that included a co-funded integration. This one wants dedicated capacity during the POC window, which changes things.
sam_engineering: Technical question — what throughput/latency are they expecting for the POC? If it's sustained 200 RPS with 128-token avg, Dedicated pricing and capacity are required.
elaine_sales: They said "interactive demo with clinicians" — target p50 latency < 250ms and p95 < 800ms. Peak ~150 RPS.
sam_engineering: p50 250ms is doable on our smaller d-pool, p95 depends heavily on model choice and batching. We need to know model and sequence length distribution.
maria_revops: For approvals: pricing deviation >30% needs VP-signed exception and finance review. Also need to confirm minimum committed spend for Dedicated conversion to trigger discount.
chris_deals: Can we offer 40% only for the 3-month POC if they commit to a 12-month dedicated contract afterward (with 20% conversion)? Structure it as: POC discount conditional on signed LOI for conversion.
jin_prodops: Also require security questionnaire + SOC2 attestation before we start ingesting PHI-like data. Any chance they'll sign a DPA?
elaine_sales: They're open to DPA. Security questionnaire inbound — they'll send today. I tagged @sam_engineering for the SLO and @maria_revops for contract language.
sam_engineering: I'll review the SLOs. Quick note: if they require KV caching across sessions + long contexts, costs go up; may need to size GPU memory accordingly.
dealbot: New deal desk ticket created: DD-2026-1127 (elaine_sales). Link: https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-2026-1127
maria_revops: Assigned to me. I'll loop in finance and legal. If finance approves provisional discount, we'll require a signed LOI and SOW before POC kick.
chris_deals: Sounds good. Elaine — please get the security Q + confirm whether any PHI will be used. If yes, legal will insist on DPA + possibly restricted on-prem/private deployment.
elaine_sales: Noted. I'll follow up with AtlasHealth legal and push for LOI language that covers the conversion. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 
sam_engineering: I'll post a short perf note in the ticket after the sim. If we need to propose a smaller model or quant profile, we'll include that as a technical alternative.
maria_revops: Closing the loop here later today after finance review. Expect an update in DD-2026-1127.
chris_deals: If finance pushes back on 40%, we can propose a stepped discount: 30% POC + 25% first 6 months of conversion. Keep options ready.
elaine_sales: Will do — thanks everyone.
